Philippine Protests Grow as Government Welcomes Trump

When Donald Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday for the first stop of his trip to Asia this week , the Philippine government rolled out the red carpet for the ally leader. But elsewhere in the Southeast Asian nation, the U.S. President’s welcome wasn’t so warm.
